protocol.type: Post-hoc data-quality sensitivity analysis, not a new independent test.
protocol.exclusion_rule: Exclude ALL members of each byte-identical input group carrying conflicting source form labels, regardless of either prediction.
protocol.preservation: Original freeze, predictions, labels and results remain unchanged. Retained rows reuse the exact original inference outputs.
protocol.scope: Complete-clip squat/push-up classification only. No retraining, threshold tuning, relabeling, target stopping, rep-count accuracy or live-speed measurement.
protocol.limitations: Source labels remaining after duplicate removal are not independently reviewed expert labels. Exact-byte audit does not detect re-encoded/near duplicates or other labeling mistakes. Previously exposed clips remain exposed.
protocol.metrics: Same binary class metrics as the original run; abstentions remain misses in all-clip accuracy and false negatives for their true class.
